textwithimage.text:
x86 Modules for dependable performance in embedded systems integration

TQ-Group offers TQ Embedded x86 Modules for embedded systems engineers. These engineering modules provide dependable performance and compatibility, which are critical for both engineering tasks and embedded systems integration.

The versatility of these engineering modules, with options ranging from energy-efficient Intel Atom to high-performance Core processors. This flexibility ensures precise alignment of computing resources with project requirements, particularly in FPGA-based designs. The robust industrial interfaces and graphics capabilities also cater to engineering applications, ensuring seamless connectivity and visualization.

Embedded systems engineers will use these modules for their processing power and compatibility. The choice of processors accommodates a wide range of performance needs, facilitating the integration of FPGA co-processing alongside x86 processors. The x86 modules' industrial interfaces and graphics support are well-suited for embedded systems across various industries.

TQ Embedded x86 Modules, powered by Intel processors, serve as reliable and adaptable components, meeting the demands of both engineers and embedded systems engineers in various applications.

text.text:
A Global Leader in High-Quality Digital Storage and Memory Solutions

Transcend is a global leader in digital storage, multimedia, and industrial products, operating 12 offices worldwide. It designs, manufactures, and sells a broad portfolio of 2,000+ products - including memory modules, flash cards, USB drives, SSDs, and industrial-grade solutions - to meet virtually any memory need.

The company is committed to strict Total Quality Control, becoming the first Taiwan-based memory module maker to earn ISO 9001, ISO 14001, and QC080000 certifications. Every product undergoes rigorous testing to ensure reliability and long-term performance.

Transcend delivers world-class embedded SSD and DRAM modules with industry-leading quality and availability.

products/boards-modules/connect-tech.jcr:title: Connect Tech Production Solutions | Connect Tech Boards & Modules
products/boards-modules/connect-tech.jcr:description: Connect Tech builds deploy-ready boards and systems for edge AI, vision, and networking. Macnica is your go-to Connect Tech distributor for product solutions.

text.text:
Connect Tech at a Glance

Connect Tech builds deploy-ready boards and rugged systems for edge AI, vision, and networking. The Connect Tech products portfolio spans NVIDIA® Jetson carriers, camera platforms, embedded Ethernet switches, COM-HPC and COM Express carriers, plus accessories and thermal solutions. Macnica Americas distributes and supports Connect Tech solutions with local engineering, supply chain scale, and custom design services.

textwithimage.text:
The Falcon Vehicle System is a production-ready, IP67-rated edge AI compute platform powered by NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX - purpose-built for agriculture, construction, and mining vehicles. Fanless and fully sealed, Falcon mounts directly on heavy equipment and supports up to four GMSL2 cameras, dual T1 Ethernet, and CAN interfaces for seamless vehicle integration. Launched at CONExpo 2026 and named Best-in-Show at embedded world Germany 2026 in AI and Machine Learning, Falcon is market-validated and ready for deployment.

 

Learn more

title.jcr:title: Why Connect Tech Solutions with Macnica?

text.text:
• Fast path from dev kit to deployable hardware across Jetson Thor, AGX Orin, Orin NX, and legacy modules
  • Vision-first I/O including MIPI CSI-2, FPD-Link III, GMSL, SDI, and HDMI capture
  • Rugged options for harsh environments, IP-rated designs, locking I/O
  • Embedded Ethernet from 1 GbE to managed 10 GbE
  • Software support with CTI-L4T BSPs aligned to NVIDIA JetPack

 

Where It Fits

Robotics, AMR, inspection, traffic and smart city, defense ISR, agriculture, construction, and autonomous machines

Get Started

Tell us your module target, camera stack, and I/O needs. We will align a carrier or system, plus thermal, cabling, and BSP.

products/boards-modules/tq-systems/tq-em.jcr:title: MBa8MP-RAS314 Single Board Computer
products/boards-modules/tq-systems/tq-em.jcr:description: Raspberry Pi fans have needed a path from prototype designs to production, and TQ has brought the solution. Enter the new MBa8MP-RAS314. TQ, known for robust,

textwithimage.text:
Powerful, Versatile and Robust Pi Alternative to Blaze a Path from Prototypes to Long-Term Production.

Raspberry Pi fans have needed a path from prototype designs to production, and TQ has brought the solution. Enter the new MBa8MP-RAS314.  TQ, known for robust, long-term embedded solutions, has crafted this platform to enhance the following: Processing (NPU) for Machine Learning acceleration, Ethernet (2 ports & TSN), Flash (NOR & eMMC), LVDS for displays, Bluetooth (5.2), USB 3.0 (4x ports + device port), Security functions, OS options (Yocto Linux, Armbian and Android-upon request), Extended temp and Long life availability.

text.text:
Features

  • Arm® Quad-Cortex® A53 on i.MX 8M Plus
  • LPDDR4, Quad SPI NOR, eMMC, EEPROM
  • Multi-display, HDMI, LVDS, MIPI DSI, MIPI CSI
  • Machine Learning Accelerator: 2.3 TOPS
  • WIFI, Bluetooth 5.2
  • 2x Gbit Ethernet (1x TSN)
  • 4x USB 3.0, 1x USB 3.0 device
  • Micro SD card
  • Raspberry Pi HAT compatible IO connector
  • Integrated security functions
  • OS: Armbian, Yocto-Linux, Android on request
  • Low Power: Typ 3W, 12 VDC
  • Compact: 100mm x 100mm
  • Extended Temp available: -40 to 70C
  • Long-term availability: 10-15 years
